g.text: WDRO reduces mean regret by 1.43–2.84% versus ERM

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: All four synthetic distributions and the ISPD test set | 3 training seeds | frozen model evaluation

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #64748b

g.text: Positive = lower regret than ERM; negative = higher regret. Reduction = (ERM − method) / ERM × 100.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #64748b

g.text: Synthetic: equal degree/seed weights; P95 computed within each degree/seed, then averaged. ISPD: pooled nets per seed, then seed average.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #64748b

g.text: Mixed ERM is stronger on Gaussian mixture and edge bias; these results do not show WDRO superiority over every baseline.
